item.title: github: Require proof of presence for high-impact actions
item.description:
GitHub Enterprise Cloud now supports requiring proof of presence before members perform high-impact actions. This adds an interactive re-authentication or MFA challenge on top of the existing sudo-style control.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: npm extends recovery-code security holds to all accounts
item.description:
npm now applies a 72-hour security hold to any account after a successful recovery-code sign-in. The hold was previously limited to high-impact accounts.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: security: Microsoft Entra ID security updates: Passkeys are the default authentication method in Entra ID
item.description:
Microsoft Entra ID now uses passkeys as the default sign-in method and introduces a new authentication model for SMS and voice. The post also points users to preparation guidance for the change.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: github: Copilot CLI no longer needs a personal access token in GitHub Actions
item.description:
GitHub Copilot CLI can now run in GitHub Actions with the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN. A personal access token is no longer required for this workflow.

  • Source: GitHub
